scope: Static safety correction and isolated mock verification of deploy/rollback_rag_ec2.sh; no Docker daemon, EC2, API, Ginder, credentials or production service used.
finding: The rollback script collected prior-container IDs via process substitution. If docker ps -aq failed while other Docker inspections still worked, mapfile could appear successful with an empty list and take the no-backup branch, removing the active RAG container.
change: Capture docker ps -aq output in a checked command substitution. On listing failure, print a refusal and exit before any removal; parse the output into an array only after success.

mock_cases: Backup listing failure exits nonzero and logs no removal of active service
Verified previous-release mock restores previous container and passes /readyz plus API/Ginder baseline checks
verification.stdout:
PASS: backup-list failure aborts without removing the active RAG container
PASS: owner-verified previous release is restored and readiness checked

limitations: Mock verification does not prove Docker/EC2 behavior, rollback ownership or the real host baseline. An owner-approved live preflight and rollback drill remain required before upgrade.
